crops.reading: Flat upright front: blue upper face and roof dome; two destination displays in raised blue surrounds over two windscreens with blue moulded frames; a bare studded steel gangway frame (round-topped) from the roof to below the headstock with the door set back in it; yellow lower half either side; '5861' black above each lamp box; red band at the bottom; orange jumper sockets and black hoses.

crops.feature: roof dome over the face: horns, orange line ends at the corners
crops.reading: Blue dome over the face, two black horns pointing up and out either side of the centre, cameras/aerials; a short orange line at each top corner, level with the displays' tops.
Two screens with blue moulded surrounds, each with its display box above the glass in the same surround; wipers pivoted at the top of each screen, blades hanging down and outwards.
Door recessed inside a deep unpainted steel frame (studs, rust); door blue above with a window in a blue frame, yellow below with a handle, red strip at the bottom.

crops.feature: yellow panel, lamp housings, red band below
crops.reading: Yellow to the corners, squared top at the screens' bottom; a recessed yellow lamp box low on each side; red band below the yellow across the whole face.
Two round lamps in a yellow rounded-rectangle box: lit white headlamp outboard (left), dark LED cluster inboard.
Same box: LED cluster (lit white dots) inboard (left), clear unlit headlamp reflector outboard (right).
'5861' in black sans numerals on the yellow.

crops.feature: front three-quarter from the left: how far the gangway frame stands out
crops.reading: From the left: the gangway frame stands well proud of the face and the door sits back inside it; the inboard LED lit red (tail), clear headlamp outboard; thin orange line along the top of the cab side.
455/7 front, identical to the 455/8 and 455/9: frame proud, door recessed, head outboard, LED inboard, orange stub at each top corner.

crops.feature: cab side: fixed window, cab door, blue and orange sweep
crops.reading: Cab side from the front: blue corner, tall narrow fixed window, cab door (hinged, tall window), then red; orange band sweeping down and forward across the cab door, blue ahead of it.

crops.feature: cab corner, cab door and first door, three-quarter
crops.reading: Corner, fixed window, cab door, one large window with a hopper, then passenger door 1 (blue leaves, yellow surround).
Two blue leaves with narrow tall windows, yellow bands on the body either side and over the top, a dark seal between yellow and leaf; grey step plate.
As door 1, seen more obliquely; the orange waist line runs to its edge on the far side.

crops.feature: windows between the doors and ahead of door 1
crops.reading: Two windows between the doors and one ahead of door 1, each with a top hopper and grey frame; pictograms beside door 1.
White arrow mark + 'South Western Railway' under the windows between doors 1 and 2.

crops.feature: second car (MSO): front end, windows, door, orange waist line
crops.reading: Second car: louvre vent by its front end, paired windows, yellow-surround doors, thin orange line under the windows, wordmark between its doors.

crops.feature: roof and cantrail over the cab car
crops.reading: Red carries up over the cantrail to the roof's curve (sky reflection band); the roof itself is grey.

crops.feature: trailing bogie of the cab car
crops.reading: Trailing bogie and underframe equipment, dark grime.
Cab car side on: sweep, cab door, fixed window, window, door 1, two windows, wordmark low, door 2, two windows; no waist line between doors 1 and 2.
Blue ahead, orange band from the roof line down through the cab door to the front foot, red behind; orange crosses the cab door.
Arrow of three strokes and 'South Western Railway', white vinyl on red, upright sans (the photo's angle shears it).
Diagram cab car: same template as the 317/320 drawings; SWT logo and an orange line where SWR put the wordmark.
Diagram nose: old rubber gangway 22 px ahead of the face, the yellow front lamp patch wrapping the corner (old front), blue/orange sweep.
